$comment: The tax-rate chips of the Add an item sheet (spec/documents.md §3.2, docs/design/design.md §6.5): the rates shown as one-tap chips, in this order, when in force on the document's date. Every other rate in force is under "Other rates". A family that is not listed (GENERIC) shows the business's own rates, at most maxChips. The hint is shown under the chips.

IN.hint: Most services are 18%. Not sure? Check once with your accountant. We'll remember it.

GB.hint: Most goods and services are 20%. Not sure? Check once with your accountant. We'll remember it.
